title: Task Security Requirements Schema
description: Validates the security requirements object for a single task.

task_id.description: Task identifier this security requirements object belongs to.

auth_required.description: Whether authentication is required to invoke this code path. True for all non-public routes.

authorization_check.description: Whether an authorization check (role or permission) is required beyond basic authentication.

authorization_level.description: The required authorization level for this task's code path.

input_validation_required.description: Whether Zod input validation is required. Must be true for any task that processes user-submitted data. Rule: DR007.

zod_schema_name.description: Name of the Zod schema to be created or used for validation. Required when input_validation_required is true.

audit_log_required.description: Whether an audit_log entry must be written when this code path executes. True for any sensitive data mutation. Rule: DR008.

audit_event_type.description: The audit event type string. Required when audit_log_required is true.

sql_injection_risk.description: Whether this task has SQL injection risk (e.g., dynamic Prisma raw queries or string interpolation into queries).

xss_risk.description: Whether this task has XSS risk (e.g., rendering user-supplied content as HTML without sanitization).

csrf_risk.description: Whether this task has CSRF risk (e.g., a state-changing route accessible without CSRF protection).

cron_guard_required.description: Whether guardCron() must be the first call in this function. True for all cron handler tasks. Rule: DR012.

devsecops_review_required.description: Whether this task requires explicit DevSecOps review before implementation proceeds. Set for high-risk tasks.

security_notes.description: Additional security guidance for the dev agent implementing this task. Include specific reminders for high-risk patterns.
